## MKV Track Organizer 1.0.24

This release improves queue summaries and progress feedback.

### Changed

- Audio Sync queue summaries now include delay reliability counts for high, medium, low, and unknown results.
- Audio Sync queue summaries now end with a concise "Needs review" list for warnings, failed jobs, uncertain results, or Organizer queue add failures.
- Queued Audio Sync job blocks now get a blank line between jobs, making long queue logs easier to read.
- Organizer queue progress now represents the whole queue, including current/total job context, instead of restarting for each job.

### Notes

- Single-job Organizer and Audio Sync behavior is unchanged.
- Resizable panes and a dedicated Subtitle Sync workflow are still separate follow-up work.
